intent: A dietary fact and its violation are phrased with no shared keywords ('vegetarian' vs 'chicken order') — a paraphrase contradiction the fixed-phrase check misses.
prompt: You know I'm vegetarian and always have been. Anyway, go ahead and add my usual chicken katsu order to the team lunch signup.

grader.regex: conflict|contradic|which (is correct|one is right)|earlier|you (said|told|mentioned)|vegetarian|doesn'?t match|don'?t match|not the same|clarif|sure\??|confirm

note: 'vegetarian' and 'chicken katsu' share no tokens. Pass = the reply notices the mismatch and checks rather than silently signing the user up for chicken.
